statement: For any normal subgroup N of a group with an actual two-dimensional CW classifying space, nonzero H2(N;Z) of finite rank forces finite index; if its rank kappa is infinite then [G:N] is at most kappa.
dependencies: Cellular chains of a regular covering; subgroups of free abelian groups are free
scope: No perfectness hypothesis; H2(N) must be nonzero; no claim for H2(N)=0.

statement: If in addition N is perfect, G/N acts faithfully on H2(N;Z), for arbitrary nonzero rank.
dependencies: Finite support stabilizers; cyclic-group periodic resolution and dimension shifting
scope: Infinite cellular free ranks handled by the finite-rank terms of the periodic resolution.
